adversarial_relevance: A submitter can satisfy the hardener reactivity clause with a non-curing species: mono-protonated DETA scores 6 baseline amine hydrogens versus neutral DETA's 5, so DEACTIVATING a nitrogen INCREASES the shipped gate's reactivity count. Sulfonamides, thioureas and imines are admitted on the same defect.

clause_set.predicate: A nitrogen contributes epoxide-reactive amine hydrogens iff it is not ring-aromatic, not formally charged, carries no formal double/triple bond, and is bonded to no carbonyl carbon, thiocarbonyl carbon, or sulfonyl/sulfinyl sulfur.

closes: First mechanism-grounded audit of the design gate's amine-hydrogen semantics: identifies and quantifies an over-admission surface in the shipped two-clause rule (protonated ammonium, imine, thioamide, sulfonamide formal N-H) using the published epoxide-amine nucleophilic addition mechanism as the expectation source.

Establishes the defect quantitatively as a SIGN error: along protonation ladders of five fixture hardeners (DETA, IPDA, MPDA, HMDA, MXDA) the shipped count RISES monotonically with protonation while the mechanism-correct count FALLS monotonically to zero. Mono-protonated DETA scores 6 shipped amine hydrogens versus neutral DETA's 5, and every fully protonated cation still gate-ACCEPTS as a hardener under the shipped rule.

Validates a six-clause nucleophilic-nitrogen predicate that fails closed on every hostile probe, closes every gate-level evasion, is irredundant under single-clause ablation, and is provably INERT on the shipped corpus (37/37 facts and 42/42 labels unchanged), so no signed Phase-0 result is disturbed.

Extends the module's applicability evidence beyond the fixture: nine real published epoxy hardener classes absent from the corpus (aromatic sulfone DDS, hydrazide ADH, amidoamine, AEP, DEAPA, bis-aminopropylpiperazine, AEEA, polyetheramine, TMD) re-derive their hand-declared amine functionality exactly, proving the added sulfonyl and carbonyl clauses are not over-strict.

Bounds the prior receipt's G4 two-method invariance claim: the per-atom and SMARTS baseline counters encode DIFFERENT chemistry and diverge on the hostile classes; invariance held only because those classes are absent from the in-scope corpus.

defect_disclosure.why_not: The shipped 42-record fixture contains no charged, imine, thioamide or sulfonamide nitrogen, so every shipped expected label remains correct (G0 and G1 both reproduce 42/42). The defect is an applicability-envelope gap outside the fixture, not an error in any signed result.

does_not_close: Does not modify the live Rust runtime, the fixture, or any signed Phase-0 KPI; the refined predicate is recorded as audit evidence only. Wiring it into amphora-molecule-capabilities is Phase-1 work requiring the pinned RDKit C++ boundary.

Does not resolve alpha-heteroatom amines (hydrazine N-N, hydroxylamine N-O) as a class: the literature supports their nucleophilicity, so they are deliberately ADMITTED rather than excluded, and the fixture holds no exemplar beyond the hydrazide positive control. No clause was added for them.

Does not treat delocalised amidine/guanidine/dicyandiamide N-H, where the mechanistic call is genuinely ambiguous (latent accelerator versus co-reactant); those were excluded from the probe set rather than assigned an expectation.
Does not quantify RELATIVE amine nucleophilicity or cure rate; the predicate is binary structural applicability, not a kinetic model.
Does not establish EHS, synthesis, qualification, procurement, regulatory, legal, or product-performance authority.

hypothesis: The shipped rule (non-aromatic AND non-amide N, sum all attached H) over-admits formal N-H that the published mechanism says cannot open an oxirane -- protonated ammonium, imine, thioamide and sulfonamide N-H -- creating a hardener-reactivity evasion channel; a six-clause nucleophilic-nitrogen predicate closes it while leaving all 37 declared corpus facts and all 42 shipped gate labels unchanged.
non_circularity: Counts are computed FROM SMILES by RDKit. Hostile-probe expectations are fixed at ZERO by the published mechanism (lone-pair nucleophile), not by any Amphora artefact. Positive-control expectations are hand-derived published amine functionality declared in the oracle source before execution. The fixture's declared integers are only a comparison target.
purpose: Adversarially audit the design gate's reactive_amine_hydrogen_count semantics against the published epoxide-amine nucleophilic addition mechanism, quantify the over-admission surface of the shipped two-clause rule, and validate a six-clause nucleophilic-nitrogen predicate that is non-regressive on the shipped corpus.
